Lead Israel from Rameses to Mount Nebo in this retro journey game. Buy supplies, set your pace and rations, answer the people's grumbling, survive attacks, and cross the water with Moses. You can save at any camp.

## Download

- **Windows (10 or later):** Download `TheExodus-Windows.exe` and double-click it. There is nothing to install. If SmartScreen appears, choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** Download `TheExodus-macOS.zip`, unzip it, and try to open the app. If macOS blocks it, go to **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. On macOS 14 or earlier, you can instead Control-click the app and choose **Open**.
- **Linux:** Download `TheExodus-Linux.tar.gz`, then run `tar -xzf TheExodus-Linux.tar.gz` and `./TheExodus`.

The apps are not code-signed, so your system may warn you the first time you open one.
